map.随时间衰减的原子核数目。: The number of nuclei as it falls with time.
map.N = N₀e^(−λt)。 一半衰期后剩约 50%。: N = N₀e^(-λt). About 50% remains after one half-life.
map.现存核数 N = N₀e^(−λt) 随时间的指数衰减。: The surviving number N = N₀e^(-λt) decays exponentially with time.

map.若 t=ln2/λ=693，则 N=500，恰好减半。: if t = ln2/λ = 693, then N = 500, exactly half.
map.N 与活度 A 关系？: Relation between N and the activity A?
map.A=λN，核数越少活度越低，二者同指数衰减。: A = λN, so fewer nuclei means lower activity; both decay as the same exponential.
map.每个核衰变概率恒定且独立，单位时间衰变数正比于现存数，解即指数。: Each nucleus has a constant and independent decay probability, so the decays per unit time are proportional to the number present, which solves to an exponential.
